intent.proves: At least one active voucher list with codes is linked to an active discount.
intent.scope: active voucher lists and discounts of both engines

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomVoucherLists v WHERE v.VoucherListActive = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomVouchers c WHERE c.VoucherListId = v.VoucherListId) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDiscount d WHERE d.DiscountVoucherListId = v.VoucherListId AND d.DiscountActive = 1)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
